offering_description.value: Ribbon sells voice networking software and equipment to telecom operators, enterprises, and government agencies. It also supplies IP routing and optical transport systems. It designs the hardware, develops the software, and helps customers deploy and modernize their networks.

primary_products.value: session border controllers; voice switching and call control software; voice gateways; IP routers; optical transport equipment

primary_services.value: network planning and design; deployment and integration; network migration; contracted maintenance and technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: fixed and mobile carriers, cloud communications providers, enterprises, utilities, and data center operators; B2G: government agencies and public safety organizations

end_markets.value: telecommunications; enterprise communications; cloud and data center networking; utilities; government and public safety

revenue_model.value: product sales: voice gateways, session border appliances, routers, and optical transport equipment; licensing or royalties: software licenses for call control, session border functions, and network management; subscription: hosted voice connectivity for enterprise collaboration platforms; service fees: contracted maintenance and technical support; project or contract: network design, deployment, integration, and migration projects
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; subscription; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops voice and network management software for carriers and enterprises; OEM / manufacturer: designs equipment built from sourced electronics and optical components for carriers and private network operators; service provider: uses network engineers and integration tools to deploy and maintain systems for carriers and enterprises
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: voice network infrastructure, IP routing, and optical transport

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: account teams serving telecom operators and large enterprises; partners / resellers: systems integrators and value-added resellers serving enterprises and government agencies; distributors / dealers: telecommunications and IT equipment distributors
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; partners / resellers; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Network equipment is subject to applicable FCC equipment rules, international conformity requirements, and export controls.
